scenario: LRST.6.9 — supersedure keys must be equality-comparable scalars. String, Int, Bool, Duration, Time, Date all admit (each supports `==` natively). Pin: an `as t.entity_id` whose slot is String-typed compiles cleanly. The companion negative case (non-comparable type) is a separate fixture.
rules_ds:
service svc.method:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.method entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 30_s as t.entity_id
